attr.title: Queue It!
attr.desc: A puzzle-platformer where planning ahead is your greatest weapon.
attr.desc_md:
In **Queue It !**, every gem gives you a special power but there’s a catch :
You have to use them in the exact order they’re in your queue !

Dash, jump, reverse gravity, phase through walls, smash obstacles, and build platforms… but think before you act. One wrong move, and your level might turn into chaos.

Originally created for **La Nuit du Code**, this expanded version features 20 unique levels.
attr.inst: Download queueit.zip on https://leo-imbert.itch.io/queue-it and copy it into the port folder (ports/queueit). Don't forget to give support to the developper.
